segments.motivation: To organize personal tasks and manage small-scale projects efficiently.
To facilitate team collaboration and visually track project progress.
To standardize and automate recurring operational tasks and workflows.

tasks.context: for personal organization or team tasks

tasks.purpose: to ensure all elements of a project or life are accounted for

tasks.context: using due dates, attachments, and 'Done' markers
tasks.purpose: to ensure timely completion and access to necessary resources
to streamline processes and reduce manual effort
to ensure coordinated effort and transparency

benefits.claim: Provides a clear, organized overview of all tasks and important information in one place.
Boosts productivity and efficiency by simplifying workflows and keeping users on top of their to-dos.
Offers a highly visual and intuitive way to manage tasks and projects using boards and cards.

frictions.claim: May lack advanced features for complex project management or detailed reporting needs compared to more comprehensive tools.
Boards can become cluttered and difficult to navigate without proper organization or if used for too many tasks.
Requires some initial time investment to fully understand and optimize its features, especially custom fields and automations.

unknowns: The effectiveness and utility of Trello's AI capabilities for text refinement, idea generation, and text summarization.
The quality and responsiveness of customer support.
Details regarding specific pricing tiers or overall value for money.
